items.raw_excerpt: On Monday, the education dept opens the Lucky Dube Secondary School of Performing Arts.
items.summary_en: A new performing arts school named after the late South African singer Lucky Dube has opened in Ermelo. It opened on Monday and will teach music and performing arts to students.
items.summary_ko: 남아프리카공화국 에르멜로에 돌아가신 가수 럭키 두베의 이름을 딴 공연 예술 학교가 문을 열었습니다. 이 학교는 월요일에 개교했으며 학생들에게 음악과 공연 예술을 가르칠 예정입니다.
items.title_en: School named after singer Lucky Dube opens

items.title_original: Education dept opens Lucky Dube School of Performing Arts in Ermelo

items.raw_excerpt: University of Zululand SRC raises alarm over academic backlog amid water outages at the institution
items.summary_en: The University of Zululand Student Representative Council is worried that students are falling behind in their studies because the campus keeps losing water. Water outages have made classes and daily campus life difficult. The SRC is asking the university to fix the problem quickly.
items.summary_ko: 줄루랜드대학교 학생회가 캠퍼스 물 공급 중단으로 학업이 밀리고 있다며 우려를 제기했습니다. 수돗물이 끊겨 수업과 학교생활이 어려워지고 있습니다. 학생회는 학교가 이 문제를 빨리 해결해 달라고 요구했습니다.
items.title_en: University of Zululand students worry about study delays caused by water cuts
items.title_ko: 물 끊김에 학업 밀려…줄루랜드대 학생회 우려 제기
items.title_original: UNIZULU SRC raises alarm over academic backlog amid water outages

items.raw_excerpt: Advoi Villagers Unite To Protect Land, Culture And Heritage.. Read more on Prudent Media Goa.
items.summary_en: Villagers in Advoi have agreed not to sell their village land to outsiders. They want to protect their land, culture, and heritage. The decision was made at a village assembly.
items.summary_ko: 인도 고아의 아도이 마을 주민들이 마을 땅을 외지인에게 팔지 않기로 결의했습니다. 주민들은 자신들의 땅과 문화, 유산을 지키고 싶어 합니다. 이 결정은 마을 총회에서 내려졌습니다.
items.title_en: Advoi Village Assembly Votes Against Selling Land to Outsiders

items.raw_excerpt: As an international, it can feel like a bit of a jungle keeping track of who’s who in the Royal Danish family. If you find yourself getting confused, here’s a (very) thorough guide to the do’s and don’t’s of speaking about the Danish Royal family.
items.summary_en: Many internationals find it hard to know the members of the Danish royal family. A new guide explains the right and wrong ways to speak about the royals. It helps you avoid offending the Danes.
items.summary_ko: 외국인에게는 덴마크 왕실의 구성원을 구분하는 것이 쉽지 않습니다. 왕실을 어떻게 부르고 말해야 하는지에 대한 안내가 정리되어 있습니다. 이 안내를 따르면 덴마크 사람들을 불쾌하게 만들지 않을 수 있습니다.
items.title_en: How to talk about the Danish royal family
items.title_original: How to talk about the royal family without offending the Danes

items.raw_excerpt: The average student loan balance has more than doubled over the past decade.
items.summary_en: A Finnish graduate says she would not take out student loans again. The average student loan balance has more than doubled in the past decade. Many graduates now start their working life carrying heavy debt.
items.summary_ko: 핀란드의 한 대졸자가 학생 대출을 다시 받지는 않을 것이라고 말했다. 평균 학생 대출 잔액은 지난 10년 사이 두 배 이상으로 늘었다. 많은 졸업생이 무거운 빚을 안고 사회생활을 시작한다.
items.title_en: Finnish graduate says student loans were a mistake

items.title_original: "I wouldn't do it again"— Finnish graduate feels the weight of student debt

items.raw_excerpt: August marks the final month of Iceland’s beloved summer. But that’s no reason to be gloomy. Quite the opposite: it’s time to make the most of the long days, warm weather, and the occasional burst of sunshine. So, to borrow the famous Transport for London slogan (“Tube it. Bus it. Train it.”), this week: climb…
items.summary_en: August is the last month of Iceland's summer, but there is no reason to be sad. It is time to enjoy the long days, warm weather, and sunshine. This week's guide suggests climbing, running, kayaking, and more.
items.summary_ko: 8월은 아이슬란드의 사랑받는 여름의 마지막 달이지만, 슬퍼할 이유는 없다. 긴 낮과 따뜻한 날씨, 가끔 스치는 햇살을 만끽하기 좋은 때다. 이번 주 가이드는 등반, 달리기, 카약과 그 밖의 활동을 추천한다.
items.title_en: What to Do This Week: Climbing, Running, Kayaking and More

items.raw_excerpt: After a hot start to August, Portugal is expected to experience a week of changing weather, with rain, cooler temperatures and sunshine all making an appearance before the heat returns later in the week.
items.summary_en: After a hot start to August, Portugal will have changing weather this week. Rain and cooler temperatures are expected, with sunshine in between. The heat is set to return later in the week.
items.summary_ko: 8월 초의 더운 시작 이후, 포르투갈은 이번 주 날씨 변화가 잦을 전망입니다. 비와 선선한 기온이 예상되고, 그 사이 햇살도 비칠 예정입니다. 늦은 주에 더위가 다시 찾아올 것으로 보입니다.
items.title_en: Portugal to See Rain, Sunshine and Hot Weather This Week

items.title_original: Portugal in for a week of changing weather: Rain, sunshine and soaring temperatures
